newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Whimsy to raise HK$41 mln in share issue.
newsitem.headline: Whimsy to raise HK$41 mln in share issue.

text.p: Whimsy Entertainment Co Ltd said it had agreed to issue 28 million new shares at HK$1.50 a share to a substantial shareholder, raising net proceeds of about HK$41 million for general working capital.

The company said Masaya Nakamura, the shareholder and a director of the company, had agreed to place 28 million existing Whimsy shares at HK$1.50 and then subscribe to the new shares which represent about 13.3 percent of Whimsy's existing share capital and about 11.8 percent of the enlarged share capital.

Nakamura currently owns 31.5 million Whimsy shares, or 15 percent of the existing issued share capital. After the placement and subscription of new shares, Nakamura would own 13.2 percent of the enlarged share capital.
Whimsy shares rose HK$0.06 in early trade on Thursday to HK$1.85.
